title: ROUTING — findings handed to another skill

inputs_read.description: Artifacts and project files read by the stage

direction_note.description: Section C's direction, under 15 lines: recommended register and why the sector implies it, two alternatives, one anti-recommendation. No hex value, no font file, no component

skill.description: A name from ui_skills_available, or null when no installed skill fits

prompt.description: The exact prompt to hand that skill: the finding, the constraints to respect (existing tokens, conformance target, sector register), and what not to change

suggested_install.description: The skill that would fit, when 'skill' is null; else null

routes.description: Every finding whose track is 'route', plus every TODO GENERATION skipped with 'needs a design decision' or 'no token satisfies the fix' — each exactly once, and nothing else
